name: Sift
description: Sifts a sound into its tones, its attacks and its air as it plays, with a level and a blur for each: tones that ring on, attacks made soft or late, air spread wide.

params.name: Tones
params.description: The level of the steady pitches in the sound, the part that stays put from moment to moment. At the bottom they are gone and only attacks and air are left.

params.name: Attacks
params.description: The level of the sudden part of the sound: hammers, picks, consonants, clicks. At the bottom every note begins without its strike.

params.name: Air
params.description: The level of what is neither tone nor attack: breath, hiss, bow noise, the room. At the bottom the sound is left clean and bare.

params.name: Sharpness
params.description: How strictly the three parts are told apart. Low shares what is in doubt between them and stays natural. High gives each part only what is surely its own.

params.name: Hold
params.description: Lets the tones ring on after the playing has let them go, at the pitch they had. Low is a short bloom behind each note, high a wash that lasts many seconds.

params.name: Soften
params.description: Smears each attack in time, so a click turns into a short puff with a soft start and a fading end. Its strength is kept and its edge is lost.

params.name: Late
params.description: Makes the attacks arrive after the tones they belong to. A little is a flam between a sound and its own strike, a lot is an echo of the strikes alone.

params.name: Scatter
params.description: Spreads the air between the two sides until left and right no longer agree, while tones and attacks stay where they were.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the sound as it came in and the three parts put back together.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on kit::Stft: a running three-way split of the spectrum by a median along time (what is steady) and a median along frequency (what is sudden), with what is neither kept as a third part.
